name: Robot biết yêu
notes: Two little robots fall in love (RobotExpressive, CC0, the same file twice: he keeps his own colours, she is recoloured rose with a bow in story.js). Stop 1: he walks in and waves at the phone, she beams in beside the card and hops over, his face goes surprised, a "!" turns into a pixel heart, he gives a shy thumbs-up and a note with the card's first words (slot note1) opens out of the heart. Stop 2: he gathers sparks into a glowing LED heart and holds it out, she nods yes, he jumps for joy and the heart floats up and projects the card's photo as a hologram polaroid with its caption (slot caption). Stop 3: the photo is saved into the heart, which rises into a disco light; they dance under sweeping coloured lights and heart confetti, then hold hands as a banner with the last words (slot note2) rises. The next tap opens the letter. The act is the shared templates/_acts/lovestory.js; this card's own moves are in story.js.

credits.author: Tomás Laulhé (Quaternius), facial morphs by Don McCurdy
